name: cod-sequoia-theme
description: Inspired by the towering presence and serene environment of sequoias, it envelops your IDE in deep blacks and browns, providing a calm and focused coding atmosphere. Accents of vibrant green illuminate the interface subtly, mirroring the vitality of these magnificent trees. Venture into the digital woods, and let its grounded, tranquil palette guide you through the logical forest of your code efficiently.
